_about: Still pictures for backgrounds, made by SDXL on Kaggle (studio/plates_gen.py). A plate is one scene + one look + a seed. Places only: no people, no text or signs, no brands or logos, no real landmarks, so nothing in a picture belongs to anyone else. school, psych and nyc are the worlds the band is set into on close__quarters (studio/scene_video.py); liminal is for nostalgia.hub.vhs, psy for psychedelic.station.
